# Twinstech Solar: AI Guidelines

> Solar, inverter, electrical, CCTV and satellite-TV installer based in Lagos, Nigeria, operating nationwide.

## About
Twinstech Solar (registered as Twinsteck Integrated Services) installs off-grid and hybrid solar power systems, inverters and battery storage (Deye, SRNE inverters; Deriy lithium batteries), solar panels (Jinko), full electrical fit-outs, CCTV and security camera systems, and satellite TV. Based in Lagos, Nigeria, serving customers nationwide. Contact is WhatsApp-first: there is no online checkout, and no contact form, on this site.

## Key Pages
- /: Homepage, positioning, all six services, a full log of five completed installs, capability summary, testimonials
- /services.html: Full specifications for all six services, with named component brands and which real jobs used them
- /our-work.html: Five completed installations in full detail, location, property type, components, capacity
- /how-it-works.html: Process from enquiry to ongoing support, plus warranty and payment terms
- /contact.html: Interactive load calculator (client-side only) and direct contact links
- /privacy.html: Privacy policy
- /terms.html: Terms of service

## Key Facts
- Trading name: Twinstech Solar. Registered name: Twinsteck Integrated Services.
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria. Operates nationwide.
- Services: solar power systems, inverters and battery storage, solar panels, electrical installations, CCTV and security, satellite TV.
- Primary contact channel: WhatsApp. No online payments are processed on this site.
- Quotes shown on-site are indicative only; a firm price is given after an actual site assessment.
- This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics. The only client-side storage is a light/dark display preference.
